## What changes?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if one exists.

## Verification

List the commands actually run and their results. State any checks you could not run.
For layout or browser changes, include before/after evidence at README and mobile widths.
For performance changes, include comparable inputs, environment, latency and memory measurements.

## Compatibility

Describe any effect on configuration, imports, captured inputs, replay or release/consumer pins.
If none, say so.

- [ ] I followed CONTRIBUTING.md and kept the change scoped.
- [ ] I added relevant positive/negative tests, or explained why tests are not needed.
- [ ] I updated affected documentation and the changelog.
- [ ] No credentials, private captures, compiled binaries or build caches are included.
